code.originalText: Five-month pernicious anemia, iron, neuropathy, and back pain review

text.paragraph: Five-month pernicious anemia, iron, and back pain review. [S]

Mrs. Oakley returns for her five-month review. She has had her monthly B12 injection each month, the latest a week ago, and takes iron every other day with mild constipation, managed with fruit and fluids. Her colonoscopy in May showed only a few diverticula. Her bladder infection in May cleared with nitrofurantoin. Her energy is normal and she teaches two full shooting classes a week and walks a mile a day. The tingling in her feet is gone, with slight numbness only at the tips of the great toes. Back pain is mild most days; she takes naproxen about twice a month after long days at the range. She has had no falls. [S]
